#functions
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

save_pheatmap_pdf <- function(x, filename, width=7, height=7) 
  {
  stopifnot(!missing(x))
  stopifnot(!missing(filename))
  pdf(filename, width=width, height=height)
  grid::grid.newpage()
  grid::grid.draw(x$gtable)
  dev.off()
}

#https://stackoverflow.com/questions/52599180/partial-row-labels-heatmap-r
library(grid)
add.flag <- function(pheatmap,
                     kept.labels,
                     repel.degree) 
  {

  # repel.degree = number within [0, 1], which controls how much 
  #                space to allocate for repelling labels.
  ## repel.degree = 0: spread out labels over existing range of kept labels
  ## repel.degree = 1: spread out labels over the full y-axis

  heatmap <- pheatmap$gtable

  new.label <- heatmap$grobs[[which(heatmap$layout$name == "row_names")]] 

  # keep only labels in kept.labels, replace the rest with ""
  new.label$label <- ifelse(new.label$label %in% kept.labels, 
                            new.label$label, "")

  # calculate evenly spaced out y-axis positions
  repelled.y <- function(d, d.select, k = repel.degree){
    # d = vector of distances for labels
    # d.select = vector of T/F for which labels are significant

    # recursive function to get current label positions
    # (note the unit is "npc" for all components of each distance)
    strip.npc <- function(dd){
      if(!"unit.arithmetic" %in% class(dd)) {
        return(as.numeric(dd))
      }

      d1 <- strip.npc(dd$arg1)
      d2 <- strip.npc(dd$arg2)
      fn <- dd$fname
      return(lazyeval::lazy_eval(paste(d1, fn, d2)))
    }

    full.range <- sapply(seq_along(d), function(i) strip.npc(d[i]))
    selected.range <- sapply(seq_along(d[d.select]), function(i) strip.npc(d[d.select][i]))

    return(unit(seq(from = max(selected.range) + k*(max(full.range) - max(selected.range)),
                    to = min(selected.range) - k*(min(selected.range) - min(full.range)), 
                    length.out = sum(d.select)), 
                "npc"))
  }
  new.y.positions <- repelled.y(new.label$y,
                                d.select = new.label$label != "")
  new.flag <- segmentsGrob(x0 = new.label$x,
                           x1 = new.label$x + unit(0.15, "npc"),
                           y0 = new.label$y[new.label$label != ""],
                           y1 = new.y.positions)

  # shift position for selected labels
  new.label$x <- new.label$x + unit(0.2, "npc")
  new.label$y[new.label$label != ""] <- new.y.positions

  # add flag to heatmap
  heatmap <- gtable::gtable_add_grob(x = heatmap,
                                   grobs = new.flag,
                                   t = 4, 
                                   l = 4
  )

  # replace label positions in heatmap
  heatmap$grobs[[which(heatmap$layout$name == "row_names")]] <- new.label

  # plot result
  grid.newpage()
  grid.draw(heatmap)

  # return a copy of the heatmap invisibly
  invisible(heatmap)
}
```

# Library
```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='hold'}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(DESeq2)
library(ggplot2)
library(pander)
library(pheatmap)
library(ggplotify)
library(dendextend)
```

# Read data
Generate meta file dynamically and read data according to this meta file
```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='hold'}
dir <- "/Users/chien/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-OIST/data/00_All_data_and_script_for_manuscript/03_figure2_atacseq_invitro/Figure2b_f/data/"

filename <- "Figure2b_f_All_Tcell_merged_data_.txt"

tag_file_annotated <- read.table(
  file.path(dir,filename),sep="\t",skip=1,quote = "",row.names=1)

title <- c("Chr","Start","End","Gene_Name","Annotation","Distance_to_nearest_RefSeq_TSS","Naive_CD4_JunB_WT1","Naive_CD4_JunB_WT2","Naive_CD4_JunB_KO1","Naive_CD4_JunB_KO2","Th0_JunB_WT1","Th0_JunB_WT2","Th0_JunB_KO1","Th0_JunB_KO2","Th1_JunB_WT1","Th1_JunB_WT2","Th1_JunB_KO1","Th1_JunB_KO2","Th2_JunB_WT1","Th2_JunB_WT2","Th2_JunB_KO1","Th2_JunB_KO2","Th17_beta_JunB_WT1","Th17_beta_JunB_WT2","Th17_beta_JunB_KO1","Th17_beta_JunB_KO2","Th17_23_JunB_WT1","Th17_23_JunB_WT2","Th17_23_JunB_KO1","Th17_23_JunB_KO2")
names(tag_file_annotated)[1:30] <- title

tag_file_annotated <- tag_file_annotated %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Row.names = rownames(tag_file_annotated))
rm(filename)
rm(title)
rm(dir)
```

# prepare matrix
```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='hold'}
countData <- as.matrix(tag_file_annotated[7:30])
mode(countData) <- "integer"
```

# prepare database 
```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='hold'}
sampleNames <-colnames(tag_file_annotated[7:30])
database <- data.frame(name=sampleNames,
                       condition=rep(c("WT","KO"),each=2),
                      celltype=rep(c("Naive_CD4","Th0","Th1", "Th2", "Th17_beta","Th17_23"),each=4))
database$sampletype <- str_c(database$celltype,"_",database$condition)
rownames(database) <- sampleNames

#in order to plot by order
database$condition <- factor (database$condition, levels=c("WT","KO"))
database$celltype <- factor (database$celltype, levels=c("Naive_CD4","Th0","Th1","Th2","Th17_beta","Th17_23"))                          

rm(sampleNames)
```

# run dds
```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='hold'}
library(DESeq2)
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData, colData=database, design= ~ sampletype)
dds <- dds[ rowSums(counts(dds)) > 1, ]
dds <- DESeq(dds)

setwd("/Users/chien/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-OIST/data/00_All_data_and_script_for_manuscript/03_figure2_atacseq_invitro/Figure2b_f/data/")
saveRDS(dds,"dds.rds")
rm (countData)
```

# read dds
```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='hold'}

dds <- readRDS("/Users/chien/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-OIST/data/00_All_data_and_script_for_manuscript/03_figure2_atacseq_invitro/Figure2b_f/Rscript/dds.rds")
```

#=============================================================================================
# run PCA
```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='hold'}
normalized_counts <- data.frame(counts(dds, normalized=TRUE))
normalized_counts_log <- log10(normalized_counts+1)
pca  <-  prcomp(t(normalized_counts_log))
print(summary(pca))
rm (normalized_counts)
rm (normalized_counts_log)

```

# PCA theme
```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='hold'}
#https://www.cnblogs.com/liulele/p/10350057.html
library(ggplot2)
pcaData  <-  as.data.frame(pca$x)
pcaData$name <- rownames(pcaData)
pcaData <- merge(pcaData, database)
percentVar  <-  round(100 * (pca$sdev^2 / sum( pca$sdev^2 ) ))

theme <-theme(panel.background = element_blank(),
             panel.border=element_rect(fill=NA),
             panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
             panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
             strip.background=element_blank(),
             axis.text.x=element_text(colour="black",size=15),
             axis.text.y=element_text(colour="black",size=15),
             axis.ticks=element_line(colour="black"),
             axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20),
             axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20),
             plot.margin=unit(c(1,1,1,1),"line"),
             legend.title = element_text(size=20),
             legend.text = element_text(size=20)
             )
pcaData$celltype<- factor(pcaData$celltype, levels=c("Naive_CD4","Th0","Th1","Th2","Th17_beta","Th17_23"))
pcaData$condition<- factor(pcaData$condition, levels=c("WT","KO"))

```

# PCA plot PC1 and PC2
```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='hold'}
p <- ggplot(data=pcaData, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, group= celltype )) + 
  geom_point(aes(shape= condition, color=celltype), size=5, stroke = 1)+
  theme +
  scale_shape_manual(values=c(15, 2))+
  scale_color_manual(values=c('#8D8D8D','#000000', '#C2293B','#820094', '#EEC156','#0000ff'))+
  xlab(paste0("PC1: ", percentVar[1], "% variance"))+
  ylab(paste0("PC2: ", percentVar[2], "% variance"))
print(p)

setwd("/Users/chien/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-OIST/data/00_All_data_and_script_for_manuscript/03_figure2_atacseq_invitro/Figure2b_f/plot/PCA")
ggsave("All-2sample_JunB_WT_KO_PCA_PC1_PC2.pdf", width = 8, height = 4)
ggsave("All-2sample_JunB_WT_KO_PCA_PC1_PC2.png", width = 8, height = 4, dpi=600)

rm(p)
```

# prepare Differential peak calling "Th17_23_KO" vs "Th17_23_WT
```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='hold'}
#We can also identify differential peaks between two cell types using DESeq2.
res <- results(dds,contrast=c("sampletype", "Th17_23_KO", "Th17_23_WT"))
resdata <- merge(as.data.frame(res), as.data.frame(counts(dds, normalized=TRUE)),by="row.names",sort=FALSE)

#filter the peaks log2 less than 1, padj less than 0.05
resdata_filtered <- resdata %>%
  filter(abs(log2FoldChange)>1) %>%
  filter(padj<0.05)

#only show gene name of filtered the peaks log2 less than 1, padj less than 0.05
resdata_filtered_gene <- resdata_filtered %>%
  left_join(tag_file_annotated, by = "Row.names") %>%
  distinct(Gene_Name) 

library(dplyr)
tag_file_subset <- tag_file_annotated %>% 
  select(Chr, Start, End, Gene_Name, Annotation, Distance_to_nearest_RefSeq_TSS, Row.names)

resdata_filtered_location <- resdata_filtered %>%
  left_join(tag_file_subset, by = "Row.names")

matrix_filtered <- resdata_filtered[,8:ncol(resdata_filtered)]
rownames(matrix_filtered) <- resdata_filtered$Row.names


```

# remove unnessasary data 
```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='hold'}
rm(res)
rm(dds)
rm(resdata_filtered_gene)
rm(countData)
```

# Heatmap with define kmean
```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='hold'}
matrix_filtered_log <- log10(matrix_filtered+1)
   
# including all samples
mat <- as.matrix(matrix_filtered_log) 
for (kmean in c(5)) {
  anno <- database %>%
  dplyr::select(condition,celltype)
  
  annot_colors <- list(
  celltype=c(Naive_CD4 = '#8D8D8D' ,Th0='#000000', Th1='#C2293B',Th2='#820094', Th17_beta='#EEC156',Th17_23='#0000ff'),
  condition=c(WT="#707070",KO="#d4d4d4"))

  range <- max(abs(mat))

}
  
```

# creat kmean gene table
```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='hold'}
p.heatmap.kmean.list<-list()
for (kmean in c(5)) 
  {
heatmap_cluster <- as.data.frame(cbind(mat,cluster=cutree(heatmap_res$tree_row,k=kmean)))

  gene_counts_subset <- tag_file_annotated %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene_Name,Row.names)
  
  heatmap_cluster <- heatmap_cluster %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Row.names = rownames(.)) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(gene_counts_subset,by="Row.names") %>%
    dplyr::select(Gene_Name,Row.names,cluster)
  
  heatmap_cluster$cluster<- paste("cluster",heatmap_cluster$cluster,sep="_")
 
p.heatmap.kmean.list[[kmean]] <- heatmap_cluster
}
  
```
 
# reorder matrix by cluster and plot heatmap
```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='hold'}
p.heatmap.kmean.list.reorder<-list()
annot_colors_kmean.list<-list()
for (kmean in c(5)) {
heatmap_cluster <- p.heatmap.kmean.list[[kmean]] 
  mat_k <- as.data.frame (mat)%>%
    dplyr::mutate(Row.names = rownames(.))
  
  mat_k <- heatmap_cluster %>%
    dplyr::select(Row.names,cluster,Gene_Name) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(mat_k,by="Row.names")
  
    rownames(mat_k) <- mat_k$Row.names
#-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

#order by cluster number
mat_k <- mat_k[order(mat_k$cluster),]

p.heatmap.kmean.list.reorder[[kmean]] <- mat_k
  
  mat_p <-mat_k %>%
    dplyr::select(4:ncol(mat_k))
  
  annotation_cluster <- mat_k %>%
    dplyr::select(cluster)
  row.names(annotation_cluster) <- mat_k$Row.names
  
annot_colors <- list(
  celltype=c(Naive_CD4 = '#8D8D8D' ,Th0='#000000', Th1='#C2293B',Th2='#820094', Th17_beta='#EEC156',Th17_23='#0000ff'),
  condition=c(WT="#707070",KO="#d4d4d4"))
    a <-unique(annotation_cluster$cluster)

library(RColorBrewer)
#checking the color set name
#https://www.datanovia.com/en/blog/the-a-z-of-rcolorbrewer-palette/#:~:text=RColorBrewer%20is%20an%20R%20package,and%20in%20R%20base%20plots.
b <- brewer.pal(length(unique(annotation_cluster$cluster)), "Set3")

annot_colors[["cluster"]] <- character()
for(i in 1:length(unique(annotation_cluster$cluster)))
  {
  annot_colors[["cluster"]][[a[i]]] <- b[i]
}  

annot_colors_kmean.list[[kmean]]<-annot_colors

}
```



#  kmean=5 heatmap order
```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='hold'}
#change kmean vale
kmean_value=5
# define order manually 
cluster_order <- c("cluster_1","cluster_4","cluster_5","cluster_2","cluster_3")

p.heatmap.kmean.list.reorder.manual <-list()
annot_colors_kmean.list.manual <-list()
 
for (kmean in c(kmean_value)) {
heatmap_cluster <- p.heatmap.kmean.list[[kmean]] 
  mat_k <- as.data.frame (mat)%>%
    dplyr::mutate(Row.names = rownames(.))
  
  mat_k <- heatmap_cluster %>%
    dplyr::select(Row.names,cluster,Gene_Name) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(mat_k,by="Row.names")
  
    rownames(mat_k) <- mat_k$Row.names
#-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    
mat_k <-mat_k %>%
  dplyr::mutate(cluster =  factor(cluster, levels = cluster_order)) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(cluster)
#-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

p.heatmap.kmean.list.reorder.manual[[kmean]] <- mat_k
  
  mat_p <-mat_k %>%
    dplyr::select(4:ncol(mat_k))
  
  annotation_cluster <- mat_k %>%
    dplyr::select(cluster)
  row.names(annotation_cluster) <- mat_k$Row.names
  
annot_colors <- list(
  celltype=c(Naive_CD4 = '#8D8D8D' ,Th0='#000000', Th1='#C2293B',Th2='#820094', Th17_beta='#EEC156',Th17_23='#0000ff'),
  condition=c(WT="#707070",KO="#d4d4d4"))
    a <-as.character(unique(annotation_cluster$cluster))
library(RColorBrewer)
#checking the color set name
#https://www.datanovia.com/en/blog/the-a-z-of-rcolorbrewer-palette/#:~:text=RColorBrewer%20is%20an%20R%20package,and%20in%20R%20base%20plots.
b <- brewer.pal(length(unique(annotation_cluster$cluster)), "Set3")

annot_colors[["cluster"]] <- character()
for(i in 1:length(unique(annotation_cluster$cluster)))
  {
  annot_colors[["cluster"]][[a[i]]] <- b[i]
}  

annot_colors_kmean.list.manual[[kmean]]<-annot_colors


#This is selected gene
dir <- "/Users/chien/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-OIST/data/00_All_data_and_script_for_manuscript/03_figure2_atacseq_invitro/Figure2b_f/plot/heatmap/"
filename <- "seleted_Th17_related_gene_list.csv"

selected_gene <- read.csv(file.path(dir,filename),header = F)
selected_gene$V3<-as.character(selected_gene$V3)

mat_k$Gene_Name<-as.character(mat_k$Gene_Name)

mat_k <- mat_k %>%
  dplyr::mutate(known_Th17_gene=ifelse(Gene_Name %in% selected_gene$V3,Gene_Name,""))

mat_k_selected <- mat_k %>%
  dplyr::select(Row.names,cluster,Gene_Name,known_Th17_gene)

labs.row <- mat_k$known_Th17_gene

mat_p <-mat_k %>%
    dplyr::select(4:(ncol(mat_k)-1))
  
annotation_cluster <- mat_k %>%
    dplyr::select(cluster)
  row.names(annotation_cluster) <- mat_k$Row.names
  
annot_colors<-annot_colors_kmean.list[[kmean]]

pheatmap_n <-pheatmap(mat_p ,
                        scale="row",
                        annotation_col = anno,
                        annotation_colors=annot_colors,
                        annotation_row=annotation_cluster,
                        annotation_names_col = F,
                        colorRampPalette(c("navy", "white", "red"))(100),
                        show_rownames = T,
                        show_colnames = F,
                        cluster_rows = F,
                        cluster_cols = F,
                        labels_row=labs.row,
                        fontsize_row = 8,
                        cutree_rows = kmean,
                        breaks = seq(-range, range, length.out = 100))
  
  pheatmap_n <- add.flag(pheatmap_n,

pheatmap_o <- as.ggplot(pheatmap_n)
pheatmap_o
```
